title: Paza: Introducing automatic speech recognition benchmarks and models for low resource languages
tldr: Microsoft Research introduces Paza, a new initiative providing automatic speech recognition (ASR) benchmarks and models specifically designed for low-resource languages. This effort aims to democratize ASR technology by offering robust tools and evaluation metrics for languages with limited linguistic data.

title: No Display? No Problem: Cross-Device Passkey Authentication for XR Devices
tldr: Meta engineering details a novel cross-device passkey authentication method for XR devices like Meta Quest, enabling secure login without a display or keyboard. This solution leverages cryptographic protocols and companion devices to streamline user experience and enhance security in the extended reality ecosystem.

title: Build with Kimi K2.5 Multimodal VLM Using NVIDIA GPU-Accelerated Endpoints
tldr: This NVIDIA blog details the process of building applications with the Kimi K2.5 Multimodal Visual Language Model (VLM), leveraging NVIDIA GPU-accelerated endpoints for high-performance inference. It provides technical guidance on integrating this advanced VLM into workflows for multimodal understanding and generation tasks.

title: How to Build a Document Processing Pipeline for RAG with Nemotron
tldr: This NVIDIA developer blog provides a technical walkthrough for constructing a robust document processing pipeline tailored for Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, utilizing the Nemotron model. It covers data ingestion, indexing strategies, and integration with large language models to enhance factual accuracy and context.

title: Accelerating your marketing ideation with generative AI – Part 2: Generate custom marketing images from historical references
tldr: This AWS ML blog details technical approaches for leveraging generative AI to create custom marketing images by drawing from historical references. It provides practical guidance on implementing a system capable of generating contextually relevant visual assets, focusing on the underlying generative models and integration strategies.

title: Nemotron ColEmbed V2: Raising the Bar for Multimodal Retrieval with ViDoRe V3’s Top Model
tldr: NVIDIA announces Nemotron ColEmbed V2, a new multimodal retrieval model, demonstrated as the top performer within ViDoRe V3 benchmarks. This release signifies advancements in efficiently indexing and retrieving information across different modalities, offering enhanced capabilities for semantic search and content understanding.

title: Unlocking the Codex harness: how we built the App Server
tldr: This engineering blog post details the architectural design and implementation of the App Server for OpenAI's Codex harness, focusing on achieving robust code execution environments and seamless API integration. It likely addresses challenges related to distributed systems, security, and scalability for serving AI-generated code.

title: Democratizing business intelligence: BGL’s journey with Claude Agent SDK and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
tldr: This post details BGL's technical implementation journey in democratizing business intelligence using the Claude Agent SDK and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. It outlines the architecture and integration strategies for deploying AI agents to facilitate data access and insights for a wider user base.

title: AI agents in enterprises: Best practices with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
tldr: This AWS ML blog outlines best practices for developing and deploying AI agents in enterprise environments using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. It covers architectural considerations, operational strategies, and common pitfalls to ensure robust and scalable agentic workflows within organizational infrastructures.

title: H Company's new Holo2 model takes the lead in UI Localization
tldr: H Company introduces Holo2, a new 235B parameter model that has established a new state-of-the-art in UI localization. This model significantly improves the accuracy and efficiency of adapting user interfaces for diverse linguistic and cultural contexts.

title: Accelerating Long-Context Model Training in JAX and XLA
tldr: This NVIDIA developer blog details technical strategies for accelerating the training of long-context models within the JAX and XLA frameworks. It explores optimization techniques, distributed computing paradigms, and hardware-software co-design to improve efficiency and reduce training times for large-scale AI models.

title: Agentic AI for healthcare data analysis with Amazon SageMaker Data Agent
tldr: This blog post explores the application of agentic AI for healthcare data analysis, leveraging Amazon SageMaker Data Agent to automate complex data processing and inference tasks. It details how multi-agent workflows can be designed to derive insights from diverse healthcare datasets, improving efficiency and accuracy.

title: Training Design for Text-to-Image Models: Lessons from Ablations
tldr: This technical blog post explores critical training design principles for text-to-image generative models, drawing insights from extensive ablation studies. it provides practical lessons and best practices for optimizing model architecture, data pipelines, and training procedures to achieve superior image generation quality and efficiency.

tldr: This NVIDIA developer blog provides critical technical guidance on implementing robust security measures for agentic AI workflows, particularly focusing on sandboxing and execution risk management.
